description: Adjusted Rand Index between Louvain/Leiden clusters and cell-type labels (bio-conservation).
Normalized Mutual Information between clusters and cell-type labels (bio-conservation).
Average Silhouette Width on cell-type labels; higher = better-separated cell types.
Isolated-label Average Silhouette Width for rare/isolated cell types.
Isolated-label F1: clustering F1 for the most isolated label(s).
Cell-type Local Inverse Simpson's Index; bio-conservation (label purity in neighborhoods).
Batch Average Silhouette Width; higher = batches well mixed (batch correction).
Graph Connectivity: are cells of the same type connected after integration (batch correction).
Integration LISI; higher = better batch mixing (batch correction).
k-nearest-neighbour Batch Effect Test; acceptance rate of batch-label mixing.
